verdict.rationale: Ghostty's docs claim a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events, and the GitHub README mentions Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents). A hands-on runtime probe of 1.3.1 on macOS, however, found no remote-control or IPC interface and concluded an external script or agent cannot send commands to or read output from a running instance, which concretely contradicts the claim. missing for 10: independently verified working scripting API, cross-platform (non-macOS) control surface, a documented API reference or OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and the ability to read terminal output programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
